resources.string: Bluetooth requires Android 10 or newer. Use Wi-Fi or USB on this device.

Scanning session\n\nChanging this session affects new scans from every scanner connected to this computer. Waiting scans keep their original session.
Could not request a session change. Check the connection and try again.

This stops future retries on this device and keeps a discard record. The computer may already have received the scan, even if it still says Waiting. Discarding here cannot remove it from the computer.
The scan is no longer waiting, or the discard could not be saved. No scan was removed.
